title: Tank lid
concept: The top of a containment tank or specimen vat: what the top-down camera sees.
sheet: Top-down photograph looking straight down at a single round heavy industrial lid for a cylindrical laboratory containment tank, on its own: a thick dark steel disc with a ring of big hex bolts round its rim, a raised round central hatch with a red valve wheel on it, two thick black rubber hoses and a bundle of cables coming off the top and bending over the edge, a thin band of yellow and black hazard stripes round the rim, worn grimy steel with scuffs and rust stains. A single object alone, whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 2,500 triangles, 1K maps. Sits on the glass: the vat (r 0.85) and the containment tank (r 1.63) scale it.
